features.heading: Edges you can actually trust
features.subtitle: No black boxes, no curve-fit signals. Just transparent conditional statistics with the context you need to judge a setup with confidence.

baseline.title: Baseline-relative edges
baseline.description: Every probability is shown next to its unconditional baseline whenever one applies. A 56% hit rate means nothing until you know the base rate — we put both side by side.

sliced.title: Sliced every way
sliced.description: Drill into stats by weekday, size bucket, prior-session candle, or session close color. Each slice carries its own sample size so thin buckets never mislead you.

refreshed.title: Refreshed daily
refreshed.description: Stats recompute automatically after each cash close, rolling in the latest session so your edges reflect this week's market — not a backtest frozen in 2019.

significance.title: Sample size next to every edge
significance.description: Every probability ships with its N — the exact number of observations behind it — right next to the edge versus baseline, so you can judge a thin slice for yourself.

faq.heading: Questions, answered
faq.a1: Each Augur stat family is graded Tier 1 to 3 by depth and conditioning complexity. Tier 1 covers headline edges like gap continuation and opening-drive direction. Tier 2 adds multi-condition slices and regime filtering. Tier 3 covers the most granular, sample-intensive studies. Your plan unlocks every stat up to and including its tier.
faq.q2: Is there a free trial, and do I need a card?
faq.a2: Every paid plan starts with a 7-day free trial, and no card is required to begin. You get full access to that plan's tier during the trial. We only ask for payment details if you decide to continue after day 7.
faq.q3: Can I change or cancel my plan later?
faq.a3: Yes — upgrade, downgrade, or cancel anytime from your account billing page. Upgrades take effect immediately with a prorated charge; downgrades and cancellations apply at the end of your current billing period, so you keep access until then.
faq.q4: How does annual billing and the 20% discount work?
faq.a4: Switching to annual billing charges you once for twelve months at a 20% discount — effectively two months free. For example, Pro drops from <mono>€79</mono> to an effective <mono>€63</mono> per month (<mono>€756</mono> billed yearly). You can switch between monthly and annual whenever you like.
faq.a5: Because the free trial lets you evaluate everything before paying, we don't routinely refund partial periods. That said, if something went wrong — a double charge or a billing error — email support within 14 days and we'll make it right.
faq.q6: Which payment methods do you accept?
faq.a6: All payments are handled securely through Stripe. We accept major credit and debit cards. Enterprise customers can be invoiced and pay by bank transfer under an annual contract.
faq.a7: No. Augur provides historical statistical information only — it is not investment advice and not a recommendation to buy or sell any instrument. Every edge is descriptive of the past; past performance does not guarantee future results.
